summary: Maris Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting its financial results for the first half of 2026 via press release. Revenues rose 194% to approximately $2.1 million; net loss was $2.8 million versus prior-year net income. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no corporate action, transaction, or special-situation event. It incorporates forward-looking statements into existing registration statements. No special-situation category applies; the filing is routine operational reporting.
